text: Entry Requirements 1. General Requirements: (1) Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign ordinary passport. (2) High school graduate (or above) with qualifications eligible for university admission. (3) Physically and mentally healthy, with no criminal record. (4) Excellent proficiency in the language of instruction. 2. Nationality Eligibility In accordance with relevant regulations, including the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, the Measures for the Administration of School Recruitment and Cultivation of International Students (Joint Decree No. 42 of the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Ministry of Public Security), and the Notice on Regulating the Enrollment of International Students in Higher Education Institutions in China Jiao Wai Han [2020]No. 12): (1) For applicants who were born in a foreign country and held foreign nationality at birth, the applicants' parent/s (Chinese-citizen side) must have obtained foreign permanent residency before the applicants' birth. In addition, the applicant must have a record of actual residence abroad (outside Chinese mainland/HongKong/Macao/Taiwan) for at least 2 years between May 1, 2023,and April 30, 2027 (calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cyclecounts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). (2) For applicants who emigrated from China and acquired foreign nationality, the applicants must have obtained foreign nationality before May 1, 2023, and completed the procedures for renouncing Chinese nationality. In addition, the applicants must have a record of actual residence abroad (outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan) for at least 2 years between May 1, 2023, and April 30, 2027 (calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). 3. For the required CSCA test subjects , please refer to Fudan University 2027 English-taught Undergraduate Programs . 4. Proof of English proficiency. TOEFL iBT score of ≥ 90 (New TOEFL ≥ 4.5), or IELTS ≥ 6.5, or Duolingo English Test ≥ 110, or PTE Academic ≥61. Applicants whose native language is English or who graduated from a high school fully taught in English can be exempt from this requirement. 5. (1) Color weakness and color blindness are not suitable； (2) Applicants must have excellent Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology background.
